text: 中国常驻联合国代表傅聪1日代表28个观点相近国家在联大第三委员会就单边强制措施作共同发言，敦促国际社会坚决遏止这一非法行径。 傅聪说，尽管国际社会反复呼吁立即取消单边强制措施，但这些非法举措继续对目标国家及其人民造成严重后果，甚至危及生命。单边强制措施以及次级制裁和过度遵守，加剧当前人道和经济挑战，严重威胁粮食、能源和金融安全。将关税作为单边胁迫工具的做法日益增多，包括依据国内法作出单方面认定、以国家安全或人权为借口加征额外关税，进一步将经贸问题政治化，损害多边贸易体制，扰乱全球产业链供应链，阻碍有关国家实现可持续发展目标的努力。单边强制措施严重违反了包
text_en: Fu Cong, China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations, delivered a joint statement on behalf of 28 like-minded countries on unilateral coercive measures at the Third Committee of the UN General Assembly on the 1st, urging the international community to resolutely stop this illegal practice. Fu Cong said that although the international community has repeatedly called for the immediate lifting of unilateral coercive measures, these illegal measures continue to cause serious consequences, even life-threatening ones, for target countries and their people. Unilateral coercive measures, along with secondary sanctions and over-compliance, have exacerbated current humanitarian and economic challenges and seriously threatened food, energy and financial security. The growing use of tariffs as a tool of unilateral coercion, including unilateral determinations made under domestic law and additional tariffs imposed under the pretext of national security or human rights, has further politicized economic and trade issues, undermined the multilateral trading system, disrupted global industrial and supply chains, and hindered the efforts of relevant countries to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals.
